text: Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 5-10: Delegation of Authority (see Appendix A) sets out the authorities delegated by the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority to Toronto Parking Authority to make financial commitments and execute documents. Toronto Parking Authority is proposing to amend the policy to update the cost thresholds, explicitly recognize the authorities related to parking management agreements, real estate activities involving lands or a portion of lands under Toronto Parking Authority's operational jurisdiction and the lack of Toronto Parking Authority's authority to acquire lands or an interest in lands. Further amendments are proposed to clarify the authority to amend or extend contracts and the authorities provided to Toronto Parking Authority to execute documents that bind the corporation.
